title: New-born strings are tensionless
summary: We report a physical origin of tensionless strings, obtained by formulating string dynamics in finite-lifetime settings for the first time. Departing from the conventional paradigm of eternal strings, we construct an inertial worldsheet confined to a finite region of two-dimensional Minkowski spacetime, known as a causal diamond. This reveals a striking result: tensionless strings arise only at the moment of their birth.
